emerging_technology: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for document-grounded language generation
intended_application: Draft Chinese and English textile product descriptions and B2B social content using approved product sheets and laboratory reports; human review before publication.
organization: Hypothetical mid-sized textile materials manufacturer inspired by the student's marketing experience. This is a teaching scenario, not a verified description of Aumerry.
industry_sector: B2B textile materials and product marketing
business_need: Reduce repeated document lookup and bilingual drafting work while retaining traceable, product-specific claims. No measured baseline or savings is supplied.
users_stakeholders: Marketing writers, product/R&D reviewers, sales staff, document owners, and business customers.
adoption_posture: Moderate/fast-follower, assumed for this case; willing to evaluate draft assistance with human approval.

additional_context: All organizational capabilities, posture and horizon are scenario assumptions.
